statusLine.command: cyan=$(tput bold; tput setaf 6); yellow=$(tput setaf 3); green=$(tput setaf 2); reset=$(tput sgr0); input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "?"'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0 | "$" + (. * 10000 | round / 10000 | tostring)'); effort=$(jq -r '.effortLevel // "?"' "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null); printf "${cyan}%s${reset}  ${yellow}effort:%s${reset}  ${green}%s${reset}\n" "$model" "$effort" "$cost"
